equipment_view.purpose: Allow 33 read-only scripts to continue working
equipment_view.sql: CREATE VIEW equipment AS SELECT master_id as canonical_id, canonical_name as name, equipment_category as category, original_nation as nation, json_extract(historical_specs_json, '$.witw_id') as witw_id FROM equipment_master em JOIN equipment_theater_usage etu ON em.master_id = etu.master_id WHERE etu.theater = 'north_africa';

equipment_battlegroup_view.purpose: Allow old scripts to access BattleGroup stats
equipment_battlegroup_view.sql: CREATE VIEW equipment_battlegroup AS SELECT eb.stat_id, em.master_id as canonical_id, em.canonical_name as name, eb.armor_front, eb.armor_side, eb.armor_rear, eb.movement_offroad, eb.movement_road, eb.he_rating, eb.ap_rating, eb.points, eb.battle_rating, eb.special_rules FROM equipment_master em JOIN equipment_stats_battlegroup eb ON em.master_id = eb.master_id JOIN equipment_theater_usage etu ON em.master_id = etu.master_id WHERE etu.theater = 'north_africa';

afv_data_view.sql: CREATE VIEW afv_data AS SELECT master_id as id, canonical_name as name, original_nation as nation, json_extract(historical_specs_json, '$.weight_tons') as weight_tons, json_extract(historical_specs_json, '$.crew') as crew FROM equipment_master WHERE equipment_category IN ('tank', 'vehicle', 'armored_car', 'self_propelled_gun');

guns_view.sql: CREATE VIEW guns AS SELECT master_id as id, canonical_name as name, original_nation as nation, json_extract(historical_specs_json, '$.caliber_mm') as caliber_mm, json_extract(historical_specs_json, '$.gun_type') as type FROM equipment_master WHERE equipment_category IN ('gun', 'artillery', 'anti_tank_gun', 'anti_aircraft_gun');
